def: An ECS setting that notices when a release's new tasks keep failing to start, stops the release, and goes back to the last working version by itself.
An extra condition on a Kubernetes pod: it only counts as ready once the load balancer says it is healthy, so old pods are not removed too early during a release.
The way to give one Kubernetes service account its own IAM role, so only the pods that need AWS permissions get them.
A program installed inside an EKS cluster that watches for Ingress objects and builds real AWS load balancers for them.
The conditions, written down before a canary starts, that stop it and send all traffic back to the stable version, such as an error rate above 1%.
